codex.how: QMD exposes generic MCP rather than a Codex-specific plugin/worker adapter. Adapt its documented qmd mcp stdio command as codex mcp add qmd -- qmd --index native-agent-stack-catalog mcp, matching adoption/templates/codex.config.template.toml [mcp_servers.qmd]; this is our native Codex wiring, not an upstream QMD-specific command recipe. The optional qmd skill install --global bootstrap is a separate adoption choice and should not silently enable model-backed retrieval on this lexical-only catalog.

official_baseline_claims.claim: QMD describes an on-device Markdown search engine combining BM25 full-text retrieval, vector search and LLM reranking through local node-llama-cpp/GGUF models. CLI lexical search is a distinct path from the complete model-backed pipeline; this capability claim does not establish a fixed percentage of token savings.

Upstream supplies structured --json/--files output and MCP query, get, multi_get and status tools for agents; selected line ranges can be retrieved using get's path:from:count form. Savings depend on retrieving the correct bounded source and accounting for both search and fetched content.

limitations.text: Retrieval is limited to configured collections and indexed files. Semantic retrieval requires embeddings; plain query automatically expands through a model, and reranking defaults on. For a deliberately lexical MCP call use typed lex searches with rerank:false; status/get and CLI search do not by themselves establish semantic readiness or token savings.

Issue #991, still open when rechecked, reports that update leaves old content searchable when an indexed file becomes empty or whitespace-only. full-save/cur/qmd/record.json records an isolated reproduction on pinned 2.8.3, beyond the issue's main-branch reproduction; that is prior local synthetic evidence, not a new reproduction in this review.

Issue #989, still open when rechecked, reports that update deactivates every document in a missing collection root while reporting success; cleanup can subsequently remove inactive data. full-save/cur/qmd/record.json records the same failure on an isolated 2.8.3 fixture; ordinary exit success is therefore insufficient as a freshness check.

Issue #971 reports a 2.8.3 stdio race where a model-free status/get request concurrent with model loading can send its JSON-RPC response to stderr and leave the client waiting. It was also reproduced upstream in CPU mode; this review has not reproduced it locally.

Issue #942 reports independent model loads across concurrent 2.8.3 invocations exhausting CPU-host RAM. Separate MCP clients do not automatically share their model processes; this matters if agents invoke expansion or reranking despite the lexical catalog's lack of vectors.

Issue #997 reports that MCP/bench can bypass the project-local custom-model trust gate. Our explicit --index selection bypasses project-local config discovery, as confirmed in tagged src/cli/qmd.ts, so this is not an observed failure of our named-index registration; replacing it with the plugin's bare qmd mcp command would remove that scope safeguard.

new_since_pin.text: No newer published release exists. All following changes are UNRELEASED on main at 04e4dbd8245c527a88f1a8f0bda547aef9ca81fb, 24 commits after v2.8.3; they are not features of our installed pin or released upgrade benefits.

Unreleased typed document metadata and a common filter AST span CLI, SDK, MCP and HTTP searches. Filters run before fusion/reranking, selective top-K completeness remains best-effort, and result metadata adds payload bytes; existing indexes require update to backfill metadata.

Unreleased embedding generation and legacy-fingerprint adoption tokenize using the store-selected embedding model, avoiding initialization of an unrelated default model and aligning chunk boundaries with the actual embedding model.

Unreleased FTS separator handling fixes punctuation-containing terms, but open issue #966 identifies a combining-mark/NFD regression introduced by that change; the report explicitly says 2.8.3 is unaffected.

Other unreleased changes validate malformed/non-object REST bodies, sanitize Windows index/config names, distinguish unreadable GGUF files from confirmed corruption, set Nix executable metadata and adjust MCP tests. They appear in the live compare's individual commits rather than all being listed in the short unreleased changelog.

The native user-scope arrangement is documented in docs/decisions/2026-09-25-codex-mcp-scope.md and full-save/cur/qmd/record.json; the upstream QMD plugin is a separate, unadopted path. examples/claude-native/agents/source-scout.md and isolated-builder.md direct scoped QMD CLI searches through their Bash-capable roles, rather than promising a QMD-specific lifecycle hook.
native_adaptation.codex_wiring: User-scope stdio MCP: adoption/templates/codex.config.template.toml [mcp_servers.qmd] uses command=${ECO_ROOT}/bin/qmd and args=[--index,native-agent-stack-catalog,mcp], and live ~/.codex/config.toml matches. The host-only .codex/config.toml has no qmd block. Sources: docs/decisions/2026-09-25-codex-mcp-scope.md, Decision 1; docs/token-session-handbook.md, Codex user-scope MCP servers; direct read of those configuration blocks. This already-explicit index means the earlier full-save/cur/qmd/gpt6.md conditional rewire is unnecessary, as full-save/cur/qmd/record.json also corrects.
native_adaptation.lane_rule: For indexed Markdown, choose the intended named index and collection, search with bounded results, then get the returned document URI and verify the relevant source lines; use a known-source read when the needed directory is outside the index. Sources: docs/token-session-handbook.md, Choose one useful context method per artifact and per-tool table; recipes/README.md#documents-and-selected-artifacts; catalogs/us-equities/native-workflows.md. The catalog setup covers catalogs/us-equities and blueprints/us-equities, not the entire repository. Codex USER scope makes the server available in fresh worktrees but does not expand its indexed corpus (docs/decisions/2026-09-25-codex-mcp-scope.md, Decision 1).

Sources: ~/.config/qmd/native-agent-stack-catalog.yml; https://github.com/tobi/qmd/blob/v2.8.3/src/mcp/server.ts ; full-save/cur/qmd/record.json, features_disabled_here.

Sources: recipes/README.md, qmd catalog row; https://github.com/tobi/qmd/issues/971 ; https://github.com/tobi/qmd/issues/942 .
deviations_from_upstream.fix: Use CLI qmd --index native-agent-stack-catalog search with an explicit collection and result limit, or MCP typed lex searches with rerank:false, then bounded get. Treat embedding, expansion, reranking or a shared HTTP daemon as separately qualified feature changes, including concurrent loading and idle-reload checks. Sources: tagged MCP query schema; rr/qmd/run.sh, model-free lexical request arguments; docs/token-session-handbook.md.

Sources: full-save/cur/qmd/record.json, recommendation; tagged CLI index-selection source.

deviations_from_upstream.what: Our automatic catalog refresh inherits two upstream 2.8.3 defects: empty files can leave stale searchable content, and missing collection roots can deactivate a whole collection while update exits successfully. Prior isolated reproductions are recorded in full-save/cur/qmd/record.json, known_defects_or_holds; upstream primary reports are https://github.com/tobi/qmd/issues/991 and https://github.com/tobi/qmd/issues/989 .
deviations_from_upstream.why: The host's ~/.config/systemd/user/ecosystem-live-clone-sync.service checks a clean Git tree, fetches/checks out main and runs qmd update; its timer uses OnUnitActiveSec=15min. Those checks do not establish that each configured collection root still exists or that newly empty source files were removed from retrieval. Source: direct read of those two unit files; ~/.config/qmd/native-agent-stack-catalog.yml.
deviations_from_upstream.fix: Before a scheduled refresh, verify each enrolled root exists and detect indexed files that became empty; check representative returned documents against disk after update and fail/report stale or missing-root conditions. Qualify an upstream fix on the retained empty-file/missing-root fixtures before upgrading; do not run cleanup while a root is temporarily unavailable. Sources: upstream #989/#991; full-save/cur/qmd/record.json, qualification_plan.

final_verdict.summary: Installed v2.8.3 matches the latest release, and standalone named-index MCP is supported, but the native catalog covers selected US-equities documents rather than the repository's adoption instructions. The true eligible isolated CLI comparison is 4,373→1,850 o200k_base tokens (57.7%) for search plus a source-verified window; the separate native Claude positive control is 5,756→3,367 (41.5%), while whole-document retrieval and search-plus-whole expand output by 0.3% and 16.9% respectively (../rr/qmd/records.json#qmd-compare-B-search-plus-window; #qmd-compare-D-claude-control; #qmd-compare-A-get-whole; #qmd-compare-C-search-plus-whole). The historical 5,756→901 claim (84.3%) is ineligible because it answered from the wrong document, and neither later valid comparison repairs that task failure or proves provider savings (evidence/artifacts/token-e2e-codex-20260926/receipt.json#corrections_to_296). The fixed scan found invocations in 64/1,010 Ultracode children (6.34%) and 11/301 Codex workers (3.65%), including 2/22 TOKEN LANES children (9.09%); this pass also confirmed a 122-document lexical catalog and used query then bounded get (invoke_by_tool.json; groups/final-verdict-evidence.json#live_probes). Next, check collection coverage before routing, use typed lex queries with rerank:false and bounded get, add refresh guards, and repair the card's stale PASS/count fields while retaining the named-index registration.
